annotations.title: Add or remove people in a Snapchat customer list

description: Add people to, or remove them from, a Snapchat FIRST_PARTY customer-list audience. Pass plain emails, phone numbers WITH their country code (+1 555 …), or mobile advertising ids — Hermoso normalises them the way Snapchat specifies and SHA-256 hashes them before anything leaves (a 64-hex value is taken as already hashed). ONE schema per call (Snapchat's rule). Values that are not valid are refused and counted, never sent. action 'remove' and 'remove_all' (empties the list) need confirm:true. Matching is Snapchat's: the reply reports what it accepted and the audience's size and targetable status read back. Free.

adAccountId.description: Snapchat ad account id shared with this profile; omit when only one is shared

audienceId.description: FIRST_PARTY customer-list audience id from list_snapchat_ads_audiences

confirm.description: REQUIRED true for remove and remove_all

identifiers.description: plain values or 64-hex SHA-256 hashes; up to 100,000 per request are batched
